User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user within the Arogya CRM, including their profile information, assigned role, and associated teamspaces. User authentication is handled externally by Firebase Auth.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for login and communication.

role.description: The user's assigned role (e.g., 'admin', 'sales_executive'). This determines access permissions and UI features.

teamspaceIds.description: References to Teamspace entities that this user is a member of. (Relationship: User N:N Teamspace)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was last updated.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Teamspace entity.

name.description: The name of the teamspace (e.g., 'Sales Teamspace', 'Marketing Teamspace').

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who created and typically administers this teamspace. (Relationship: User 1:N Teamspace)

memberIds.description: References to Users who are members of this teamspace, granting them access to its data and modules. (Relationship: Teamspace N:N User)

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the teamspace was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles, including their assigned role and the teamspaces they are members of. This document is crucial for role-based and teamspace-based authorization checks. Users can typically only read/write their own profile, while 'admin' users have broader management rights. Includes denormalized 'role' and 'teamspaceIds' array for authorization independence.

Represents an isolated workspace for a team. This is the root for all team-specific data. It includes a 'memberIds' array for explicit team membership, enabling direct authorization checks. Only members of a teamspace can access its associated data.

Stores potential customer leads, isolated per teamspace. Each lead document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'assignedToIds' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the assigned sales executives.

Stores established contacts, isolated per teamspace. Each contact document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace.

Stores company or organization accounts, isolated per teamspace. Each account document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the account owner.

Stores sales opportunities, isolated per teamspace. Each deal document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the deal owner.

Stores tasks, isolated per teamspace. Each task document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'assignedToId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the assigned user.

Stores scheduled meetings, isolated per teamspace. Each meeting document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard), 'organizerId', and 'attendeeIds' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace, the organizer, and attendees.

Stores logged phone calls, isolated per teamspace. Each call document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'callerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the caller.

Stores CRM documents and their metadata, isolated per teamspace. Each document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'uploadedById' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the uploader.

Stores marketing campaigns, isolated per teamspace. Each campaign document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the campaign owner (typically 'marketer' role).
Stores globally available product catalog information, with denormalized price and stock for performance. Accessible to all relevant roles (e.g., sales, marketing for read, admin/ops for write).

Stores sales quotes, isolated per teamspace. Each quote document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the quote owner.

Stores confirmed sales orders, isolated per teamspace. Each sales order document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the order owner.

Stores purchase orders, isolated per teamspace (e.g., 'Operations Teamspace'). Each purchase order document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the order owner.

Stores invoices issued to customers, isolated per teamspace. Each invoice document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'ownerId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the invoice owner.

Stores customer support tickets, isolated per teamspace (e.g., 'Support Teamspace'). Each ticket document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'assignedToId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the assigned support agent.

Stores customer refund requests, isolated per teamspace. Each refund document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard), 'requestedById', and 'processedById' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the relevant users.

Records and manages customer complaints, isolated per teamspace. Each complaint document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'assignedToId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the assigned agent.

Records significant actions and changes for audit trails, isolated per teamspace. Each activity log document contains its 'teamspaceId' (matching the path wildcard) and 'userId' for authorization independence. Access is restricted to members of the respective teamspace and the user who performed the action.

firestore.reasoning:
The recommended Firestore structure prioritizes secure, scalable, and debuggable authorization by adhering to the core design principles: Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and consistent Access Modeling. Most CRM data is organized under a 'Teamspace' hierarchy, ensuring strict data isolation per team, a key requirement for a SaaS-style CRM.

**Authorization Independence:** This is achieved through extensive denormalization. For instance, every document within a teamspace-scoped subcollection (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Tasks, etc., and critically, all 'Line Item' sub-subcollections) will explicitly include its `teamspaceId`. This allows Firestore Security Rules to verify a user's access by checking if `request.auth.uid` is a member of the `teamspaceId` (by checking the `teamspaceIds` array on the user's own `/users/{userId}` document, which is a single `get()` operation per request for the user's profile, a standard and efficient practice for DBAC), rather than performing costly and complex `get()` operations on parent documents. Similarly, fields like `ownerId`, `assignedToId`, `uploadedById`, `organizerId`, `callerId`, `requestedById`, and `processedById` are stored directly on the respective documents, enabling direct authorization checks.

**Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):** Data is segregated into distinct collections based on its security requirements. Global catalog data (Products, PriceBooks, ProductPrices, Stock) resides at the root level, accessible based on a user's role. Most operational CRM data, however, is nested under `/teamspaces/{teamspaceId}/` to enforce strong data isolation. This means all documents within, for example, `/teamspaces/{teamspaceId}/leads` will share the same `teamspaceId` and thus the same primary access rules, simplifying security rule logic.

**QAPs (Queries are not Filters):** The hierarchical structure `teamspaces/{teamspaceId}/<entity_plural_name>/{entityId}` inherently supports Query as a Security Primitive. When a user queries a collection like `db.collection('teamspaces').doc(myTeamspaceId).collection('leads')`, the results are naturally scoped to `myTeamspaceId`. Security rules then only need to verify that `request.auth.uid` has access to `myTeamspaceId` (i.e., is a member of that teamspace), and potentially other role-based or ownership-based conditions on the document itself. This prevents inefficient filtering of large result sets by security rules and ensures that only authorized data is ever returned.

**Role-Based Access Control (DBAC):** User roles are stored explicitly in the `/users/{userId}` document. The `teamspaceIds` array on the user document also facilitates quick lookups for teamspace membership. Admin users are granted broad access based on their 'admin' role, while other roles (sales_team_lead, sales_executive, marketer, support) have access confined to their assigned teamspaces and/or documents where they are an `ownerId` or `assignedToId`.

This architecture provides a clean, predictable, and highly secure foundation for Arogya CRM, making security rules simpler to write, understand, and debug, while maintaining scalability and performance.
